title: Redemption Queues behind Quarterly Gates: Requests, Rationing, and Balance-Sheet Adjustment in Semi-Liquid Private Credit Funds, 2023–2026 — replication code and results
description: Code, results files and generated tables for the manuscript of the same title. All inputs are public SEC EDGAR filings (Schedule TO-I/A, 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K). Every table and every number in the manuscript is generated from the results JSON files in this repository by code/make_tables_v3.py; the results are produced from the filings by the scripts in code/ (see README.md for the order). The pre-registration of the next-cycle tests, frozen on 22 October 2026 before any of those filings existed, is in preregistration/.
